entities.summary: Emil Løjborg Kristensen is a Danish professional ice hockey defenceman. He is currently under contract with HC Pustertal Wölfe of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He previously played with KooKoo in the Finnish Liiga, initially signing a one-year contract with the team in 2017 after playing in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL).
